component.name: Shokzer
component.summary: Change settings on a Shokz OpenRun Pro 2

description.p: Reads the battery, firmware and EQ of a Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 connected to this computer, and changes the EQ preset, custom EQ and multipoint where those are verified for the headset's firmware. Playback and calls stay with the system audio stack.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Shokz.
First local build: diagnostics, status, EQ and multipoint.
